name: Coqui TTS
overview: A mature open-source TTS library supporting XTTSv2 for high-quality voice cloning.
details: Coqui TTS provides a robust server for XTTSv2, allowing zero-shot voice cloning from just a 3-second audio sample.
While the company has shut down, the open-source repository remains heavily utilized. However, it requires significantly more VRAM than newer models like Kokoro.
